rollbackHeaderModel.limitation: Solvability and exact RPM headers only; not an OS restore or installed-package rollback rehearsal.

limitations: CVE association is the installed advisory catalog, not proof of exposure or coverage of every CVE by every selected package. Compare exact EVR and architecture before approval.
No live DNF cache refresh or package installation. Metadata must be revalidated before a future approved transaction.
No installed-package/scriptlet rollback or boot restoration test was performed.
RHCK auxiliary packages excluded from the UEK scenario remain outside its scope.
No nginx stream upgrade and no general OS update is proposed.
